historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to build the Lake Merced Sports Center to Ira H. Larsen Co., the lowest of six bidders, for $262,261 with alternates.

The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract for the 1955 bond program's boat launching facility at Lake Merced, moved beside the Aquatic Center Building from a first site too near the gun clubs, to the Duncanson-Harrelson Co.; the lake then had some 287 sailboats and was the Sea Scouts' headquarters.
